title: Q-GROW-CHANGELOG-FEED: GROW-1: public changelog feed (RSS and JSON) built from the merged-change record
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order (growth items first when the recent growth share is below target)
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::changelog.xml
**Status:** open

Owner directive 2026-11-12: product management is growth, not only bug fixes. Growth item: it adds a capability, a surface, a reader or a customer path.

Add /changelog.xml (RSS) and /changelog.json served from the same snapshot as /live (merged changes by day, size, origin; no repository contents). Link it from /live, llms.txt and the API catalog so readers and agents can subscribe to the fact that the system keeps shipping.
Paths: site/worker.js, site/live.js, site/agentic.js, site/site.test.mjs.
Acceptance: the feed validates as RSS 2.0, lists the last 30 days, and a test covers it.
Metric moved: agent_hits_7d, visitors_7d. Prediction: agent_hits_7d rises at least 15 percent within 14 days.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:site/worker.js::changelog.xml and the stated metric measured after the change (keep only if the target moved and no guard worsened).
